name.note: State Street writes it with trademark signs (State Street® SPDR® S&P®/ASX 200 ETF). Renamed on 19 Dec 2025; before that it was the SPDR S&P/ASX 200 Fund. State Street says the strategy did not change. First ETF listed in Australia (Aug 2001).

yield.note: State Street's 1-year 'Fund Distribution Return' to 30 Sep 2026: the part of the 1-year total return that came from distributions (NAV basis, distributions reinvested). The last four distributions (ex 30 Dec 2025 to 29 Sep 2026) total A$3.02 a unit, about 3.8% of the 16 Oct 2026 NAV. State Street's 'Dividend Yield' (dividend yield of the shares it holds) was 3.40% at 16 Oct 2026. Excludes franking credits.

franking.note: State Street does not publish a franking percentage, only franking credits per unit for each distribution. Worked out from those for FY2026 (ex-dates 29 Sep 2025 to 29 Jun 2026): 81.3 cents of credits on A$2.91 of cash distributions, so about 65% of the cash was franked (assuming a 30% company tax rate). For the last four distributions it is about 67%.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception; ASX quotation date 27 Aug 2001 (State Street)
